payload.title: Per-publication moderation mode setting
payload.description:
As a publication admin, I want to choose how moderation works, so that each site can start strict and relax as trust grows.

Modes: off (no review; content stays public), human (queue; content is public immediately and may be hidden afterwards, or optionally held until approved), ai (AI decides, humans may override), ai-with-human-review (AI decides, flagged items go to the queue). Stored as publication data, not code.

```gherkin
Feature: Moderation mode
  Scenario: Default
    Given a publication with no moderation setting
    Then public content is visible immediately and nothing is queued

  Scenario: Human mode
    Given moderation mode "human"
    When a reader submits content
    Then it is visible immediately and appears in the moderation queue

  Scenario: Hold until approved (optional)
    Given moderation mode "human" with pre-moderation on
    Then new content is not publicly visible until approved

  Scenario: Mode change
    When an admin changes the mode
    Then the change is recorded with who and when
```
